$comment: The share images and social posts, from the agd-playground share-image editor (src/components/context-og: draw.ts, Playground.tsx; routes /context-og-image-playground and /context-social-post). Layout rules are the engine's (src/assets/og.ts); this file holds the brand's part: palettes as token names, sizes (ids and pixels shared by every brand, src/design/platforms.ts), each template's settings, the sample copy --sample fills in, and the card colors. Where the editor's hex had no token, the nearest token is used (see notes).
notes: Paper and Mist ink: the editor's #0a0a0a is black (text-default).
Mist ground: #eeeeee is bg-frame (#F2F2F2); its field #cfd0d6 is neutral-20 (#CCCCCC).
Night: ground #0b1220 is navy-20 (#07142F), dots #dbe6ff are blue-20 (#D3E0FB), rings and mark #7f9fe8 are blue-60 (#7CA1F3), field #1f2b47 is navy-30 (#0B1E46).
Graphite: ground #161616 is neutral-90 (#191919), dots and mark #0a6cff are brand (#2563EB), field #2a2a2a is neutral-80.

Cards: heading #0a0a0a is text-default, body #52525b is text-secondary (#595959), the card edge is border-hairline (8% black, the editor drew 10%), the card shadow is shadow-floating's drop (8px down, 24px blur, 12% black; the editor drew 16% navy).
On a fill (the products panel, buttons, chips) words take the ground's color; on Ink and Graphite that is under 4.5:1 on the brand blue (black 4.1, neutral-90 3.4), so they are white (5.2).
